main_text.l: observaverit disciplinam, & prae caeteris ver-bo Dei, & doctrinae operam dederit, dubium
non est ex his quae ad nos laboris & studii ejus
per eos tractatus quos paene quotidie in Eccle-
sia habebat ex tempore: quos & describentes
Ruffinus interpres, quod idem est: Nam
Latini vocare solent tractatus, quas Graeci di-
cunt Homilias; nec mirum si Origenes
ex diuturnā exercitatione, ut nos docuit
immeritò à Viro docto fuisse notatum,
ante sexagesimum primum ætatis suæ an-
verisimile est falso codicis titulo de-
niam in illis Homiliis eximias illas ingenij
quæ in germanis Origenis scriptis micare

page.notes: The printed form "Hietonymum" in the third paragraph is kept as printed; it is probably a printing error for Hieronymum. The text continues on the next page ("micare" ends the page mid-sentence). The vowel with a mark in "diuturnā" is read as a macron. The section number "XIX." stands in the right margin beside the second paragraph. No catchword is visible.
